text: A call was received informing that one boy theft a mobile phone from a patient at NIMS BanjaraHills. ERV 0599 was dispatched immediately. ERV reached on the spot within 03 minutes and caught the boy nearby medical turn.
A call was received informing that a person had been assaulted by individuals and Rs. 12000 was snatched. ERV 0418 reached on spot within 01 minute and apprehended three boys.
Some persons in a black Scorpio snatched a woman's phone and fled. ERV 0600 reached within 03 minutes and caught the suspects.
